confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2004 (Blender BL-7, Home category, AED 279.00) was delivered 2026-10-24T12:10:00+04:00; the return was requested 2026-10-27T21:00:00+04:00, 3.4 days after delivery, inside the 14-day Return v2 window for non-electronic home items.
The return parcel was picked up at 2.34 kg (CE-039) and received at 2.33 kg; the weights are consistent with the 2.30 kg dispatch weight within normal tolerance of the checks.
The item is not serialised, so no serial comparison applies.
The customer reported a burning smell from the motor on first use.
The courier timeline is in order after UTC conversion and the parcel was delivered to the Returns Centre on 2026-10-30.

findings.description: The warehouse inspection records only 'possible damage', with no note, no photo and no statement on whether the motor fault was tested. The reported fault is therefore neither confirmed nor ruled out. This is a gap in the record, not a finding about any person.

policy_references.quote: Items returned for a fault are eligible for a refund or replacement within the window if the fault is confirmed at inspection.
The defect must be confirmed by warehouse inspection or a technician report.
Missing evidence is requested from the party that holds it (seller, courier, warehouse or customer). Never assume what it would show.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the applicable window and the parcel weights are consistent. The fault the customer reported is not confirmed because the inspection note is vague and has no photo. A clarification request to the Warehouse is drafted; a refund or replacement review should wait for its answer.
findings.uncertainty_note: No scans or photos exist for this return or order, and the inspection has no note. Whether the motor fault is real, and whether it is a manufacturing defect rather than misuse, is unknown until the Warehouse responds.
